scope: A return statement in a finally suite of the same function or async function. Identify the nearest finally suite; record the return range and its owning try line.
finding: If this return runs and completes, it exits the function from cleanup and can replace a pending return or suppress a pending exception.
review_guidance: Check the expected success return and exception propagation separately. Consider moving normal return logic after cleanup only once both behaviors have tests. Confirm intentional suppression before changing behavior.
limitations: This syntax check does not establish reachability, intent, a pending exception, or a confirmed bug.
Nested function and class scopes have their own cleanup context. Break and continue are outside this proposal.
The evaluator reports source that cannot be compiled for its recorded Python version as a separate status.
CPython 3.14 also warns about the pattern. A later value assessment should compare usefulness and overlap against that warning.
